programme.title: Sigabo[Live] / Sigabo[直播]
programme.desc: The series explores the stark contrast in the lives of two individuals: Gabo (Martin), a spunky, street-smart man from a vibrant, humble community, and Samantha (Montes), a tough, fearless law enforcer from a highly affluent and privileged background. It blends action, romance, and comedy as their paths cross and their different worlds collide.

programme.title: Someone, Someday[Live] / Someone, Someday[直播]
programme.desc: Someone, Someday follows Billy (Kathryn Bernardo), the young CEO of a dating app that empowers women to find their destined true love-while secretly carrying the heartbreak that has kept her from finding her own. Driven by her unwavering love for her friends and family, especially her younger brother who she raised by herself, Billy must confront the wounds she's spent years hiding before she can reclaim her dreams-and finally discover whether someone, someday, was meant for her after all.

programme.title: The Loyalty Game[Live] / The Loyalty Game[直播]
programme.desc: A wife puts her husband to a simple loyalty test, unaware she will unleash a dangerous game of seduction, secrets, and deadly deception. After a troubled night leaves Ana waking up without her husband Ben by her side, she hires Beth to test his loyalty by seducing him. The connivance between wife and loyalty tester soon turns into a dangerous, seductive psychological game of secrets, manipulation, and power play, where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The Iron Heart
programme.desc: The Iron Heart follows Apollo Adelantar, an undercover operative with a traumatic past who is assigned to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate. As he goes deeper into his dangerous mission, Apollo is forced to confront painful truths about his identity, loyalty, and family-especially when trusted allies turn into enemies. Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.

programme.title: The General's Daughter
programme.desc: Rhian Bonifacio, an AFP military nurse, secretly works as a spy for the man she believes is her father, Santiago Guerrero, who has raised her to seek revenge against military general Marcial de Leon. As Rhian uncovers the truth about her origins, she finds herself torn between loyalty to the family that raised her and her duty to justice, leading to a dangerous conflict involving family, betrayal, and redemption

programme.title: La Vida Lena
programme.desc: La Vida Lena is a revenge drama about Magda, a talented young woman who is bullied because of a facial scar. After creating a successful beauty soap formula, she becomes the target of the powerful Narciso family. Betrayed and stripped of everything she loves, she returns with a new identity and appearance, determined to exact revenge on those who destroyed her life.

programme.title: TV Patrol Global Edition
programme.desc: ABS-CBN's flagship newscast and the country's leading news program in the past two decades, anchored by the most celebrated news team ever assembled in the history of Philippine broadcasting.

programme.title: Santigwar
programme.desc: Hasmin, a young Santigwar who inherited her father's mystical ability to heal and battle supernatural beings, has spent years hunting the aswang clan responsible for her mother's death. When a group of unwitting teenagers arrives in her town, their presence triggers a series of encounters that bring Hasmin face‑to‑face with long‑hidden truths linking her own family to the very monsters she seeks.

programme.title: (DL) World News

programme.title: Batie Girl / 巴铁女孩
programme.desc: Lu You, a famous young Chinese female footballer, is struck by injury and that puts an end to her sports career. She is down into the dumps and comes to the droughty, poor and backward village in north Pakistan to escape from it, where she accidentally helps the little girls realize their football dreams and alters the course of the girls' miserable life - getting married at the age of 13. For Lu You, the kindness and innocence of the Pakistani girls gradually opens up her heart that's been long shut to the outside and revives her confidence to step up to life. In the end, new sources of water in the village are gotten through by the Chinese enterprises which offer assistance to the construction of Pakistan due to the effort of this Chinese girl, thus radically changing the predicament of poverty and backwardness here.

programme.title: Batie Girl / 巴铁女孩
programme.desc: Lu You, a famous young Chinese female footballer, is struck by injury and that puts an end to her sports career. She is down into the dumps and comes to the droughty, poor and backward village in north Pakistan to escape from it, where she accidentally helps the little girls realize their football dreams and alters the course of the girls' miserable life - getting married at the age of 13. For Lu You, the kindness and innocence of the Pakistani girls gradually opens up her heart that's been long shut to the outside and revives her confidence to step up to life. In the end, new sources of water in the village are gotten through by the Chinese enterprises which offer assistance to the construction of Pakistan due to the effort of this Chinese girl, thus radically changing the predicament of poverty and backwardness here.

For Lu You, the kindness and innocence of the Pakistani girls gradually opens up her heart that's been long shut to the outside and revives her confidence to step up to life. In the end, new sources of water in the village are gotten through by the Chinese enterprises which offer assistance to the construction of Pakistan due to the effort of this Chinese girl, thus radically changing the predicament of poverty and backwardness here.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians / 鏢人: 風起大漠
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive Zhi Shi Lang across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Smashing Frank / 搗破法蘭克
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves "Frank," their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe / 遇見你之後
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Peng and Mang have nothing in common but spend a magical night in Rome together. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: Cliff Walkers / 懸崖之上
programme.desc: The first spy thriller movie by famous Director Zhang Yi Mou, this film follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret operation in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo in 1932. Sold out by a traitor, the agents, who split up into two teams, find themselves surrounded by threats on all sides. Can they complete their mission?

programme.title: Look Up / 一樣的天空
programme.desc: This film celebrates the 25th anniversary of Hong Kong’s Handover in a series of four cultural stories about young Hong Kongers from different walks of life: a young man with autism pursuing his dream, a reconciliation between father and son, a Chinese opera star helping young pop singers, and a Nepali youth becoming a professional lion dancer.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box / 西遊記第壹百零壹回之月光寶盒
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Wild City / 迷城
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owner's deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: Shining for One Thing / 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the college entrance exam, but an accident changes everything tragically. As Zhang feels helpless and devastated, he fortuitously travels back in time with Lin before the accident happens. Can he make amends and convey his regrets this time?

programme.title: Beyond The Sin / 惡行之外
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wen’s imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon / 8塊錢富豪
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Man on the Edge / 邊緣行者
programme.desc: On the eve of the 1997 handover, violence is rampant with triad forces causing chaos in Hong Kong. The triad gang leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business. However, Ah Lok turns out to be an undercover police officer who unveils a shocking political conspiracy during the investigation.

programme.title: A Writer's Odyssey II / 刺殺小說家2
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: Last Suspect / 拯救嫌疑人
programme.desc: Lawyer Chen receives a mysterious call demanding her to defend a murder suspect after her daughter is kidnapped, and is told that she can only save her daughter by winning the case. As she starts investigation with the police and evidence emerges, Chen discovers the truth and reveals the mastermind. Can she rescue her daughter in time?

programme.title: Trending Topic / 熱搜
programme.desc: Chen Miao, an online media editor-in-chief, wrote a popular article which has become a trending topic. This however, led indirectly to a girl’s suicide. After receiving a help request, she realises that there is more to the story than meets the eye. As public opinion sways on the case, a war to speak up for the weak has begun!

programme.title: Bursting Point / 爆裂點
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yang's rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun!

programme.title: Night and Fog / 天水圍的夜與霧
programme.desc: Following “The Way We Are”, this is based on a true story happening in Tin Shui Wai. It revolves around an older, unemployed Hong Kong man, his young Mainland wife and their two daughters. Their lives, unfortunately, are anything but easy, and the shocking conclusion raises issues about the plight of the socially deprived lower class.

programme.title: As It Burns / 白晝如焚
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates the death of Yan Zhen in an explosion which seems more than an accident to him. Wei then finds out that Yan Zhen looks a lot like Yin, the girlfriend of Yan Zhen’s childhood friend Lu, and uncovers a tangled web of deceit leading to surprising revelations when he merges details from the past and the present.

programme.title: The Monkey King 3 / 西遊記·女兒國
programme.desc: Monkey King, Pigsy and Sandy escort Monk Tang to retrieve the scriptures and accidentally head into the mysterious Female Kingdom. The Queen falls in love with Monk Tang at first sight, but her advisor orders Monk Tang and his disciples to be executed. As the four attract the appearance of River Spirit, the Female Kingdom is plunged into crisis!

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians / 鏢人: 風起大漠
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive Zhi Shi Lang across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: I Want to be Rich / 做個有錢人
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. Against all odds, his resilience and determination to provide a better life for his family eventually lead him to achieve significant success in real estate—a testament that perseverance pays off.

programme.title: Dead To Rights / 南京照相館
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: Mad Fate / 命案
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung’s mad fate?

programme.title: No One Like Me / 大奉打更人之世間無我這般人
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: Pass and Goal / 逆轉上半場
programme.desc: After a stock crash wipes out everything she has built, a businesswoman starts over in Sham Shui Po, forming a grassroots kids' football team. Guided by a disabled coach, they prepare to face an elite squad backed by wealthy families. Caught between ambition and conscience, she resolves to use her second half to rewrite the children's first.

programme.title: The Wig / 戴假髮的人
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a law graduate overwhelmed by despair after failing the bar exam three times and vents his frustration on a drunken passenger one stormy night. Twenty years later, Meng is a successful lawyer, but his investigation into a sexual assault case involving a young girl rekindles haunting memories he cannot escape.

programme.title: Trending Topic / 熱搜
programme.desc: Chen Miao, an online media editor-in-chief, wrote a popular article which has become a trending topic. This however, led indirectly to a girl’s suicide. After receiving a help request, she realises that there is more to the story than meets the eye. As public opinion sways on the case, a war to speak up for the weak has begun!

programme.title: Bursting Point / 爆裂點
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yang's rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun!

programme.title: Night and Fog / 天水圍的夜與霧
programme.desc: Following “The Way We Are”, this is based on a true story happening in Tin Shui Wai. It revolves around an older, unemployed Hong Kong man, his young Mainland wife and their two daughters. Their lives, unfortunately, are anything but easy, and the shocking conclusion raises issues about the plight of the socially deprived lower class.

programme.title: As It Burns / 白晝如焚
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates the death of Yan Zhen in an explosion which seems more than an accident to him. Wei then finds out that Yan Zhen looks a lot like Yin, the girlfriend of Yan Zhen’s childhood friend Lu, and uncovers a tangled web of deceit leading to surprising revelations when he merges details from the past and the present.

programme.title: The Monkey King 3 / 西遊記·女兒國
programme.desc: Monkey King, Pigsy and Sandy escort Monk Tang to retrieve the scriptures and accidentally head into the mysterious Female Kingdom. The Queen falls in love with Monk Tang at first sight, but her advisor orders Monk Tang and his disciples to be executed. As the four attract the appearance of River Spirit, the Female Kingdom is plunged into crisis!

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians / 鏢人: 風起大漠
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive Zhi Shi Lang across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: I Want to be Rich / 做個有錢人
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. programme.title: Dead To Rights / 南京照相館

programme.title: Mad Fate / 命案

programme.title: Ghost Sniper / 幽靈狙擊手
programme.desc: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

programme.title: Ghost Story / 聊齋新傳之畫皮人
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Sheng fortuitously rescues the fox demon Xiang Er and brings her home. Unaware of her identity, he falls in love with her, hoping for her to become his concubine. However, Xiang Er is manipulated by the old demoness to do evil and harm people. Will their paranormal love triumph over darkness, allowing them to live happily ever after?

programme.title: Crocodile Island / 鱷夢島
programme.desc: A reality adventure show takes place on Crocodile Island, where participants from diverse backgrounds compete for a priceless golden egg. They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

programme.title: Fighting Darksider / 屠魔戰神
programme.desc: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhang's son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the sword's power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

programme.title: Gold Medal Protection / 金牌保鑣
programme.desc: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Ning's sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Ning's sister?

programme.title: Laoshan Taoist / 嶗山道士
programme.desc: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the master's teachings of "Think No Evil". As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

programme.title: Brother Wolf / 臥狼行動
programme.desc: Recruited from prison for an undercover mission, convict Da Fei returns to the criminal underworld to investigate his former sworn brother, who stole a cartel drug shipment. However, when ruthless mercenaries kidnap his mother, Da Fei joins forces with border police in a desperate battle for justice and redemption.

programme.title: Detective Dee: The Sky Red-eye / 狄仁傑之恢詭赤目
programme.desc: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wu's birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

programme.title: Master So Dragon Subduing Palms 2 / 降龍神掌蘇乞兒2
programme.desc: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

programme.title: Infernal Storm / 無間風暴
programme.desc: Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shan's identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jin's conspiracy.

programme.title: The Tai Chi Master / 張三豐
programme.desc: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

programme.title: Eye for an Eye / 目中無人
programme.desc: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

programme.title: Headless General / 竊天書之無頭將軍
programme.desc: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

programme.title: Ultra Protection / 非常保鏢
programme.desc: Tong Song is a genius but unfortunately lost his limbs in a car accident. He sets up a security services company with a computer expert and a skilful fighter, and their first job is to protect a dog. The job seems quite simple, but it turns out to be a perilous task as they unravel a conspiracy behind the mission.

programme.title: The Mystical Treasure / 白門五甲
programme.desc: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

programme.title: Crazy Beggar SuQiEr / 瘋魔神捻蘇乞兒
programme.desc: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opium's harm on people.

programme.title: My Kungfu Girlfriend / 我的野蠻女掌門
programme.desc: Yu Sheng Nan rushes to get married to fulfil her dying father's wish and forces Niu, a man she just knew, to sign a bogus marriage agreement. As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Niu's safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

programme.title: Crazy Beggar SuQiEr / 瘋魔神捻蘇乞兒
programme.desc: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opium's harm on people.

programme.title: My Kungfu Girlfriend / 我的野蠻女掌門
programme.desc: Yu Sheng Nan rushes to get married to fulfil her dying father's wish and forces Niu, a man she just knew, to sign a bogus marriage agreement. As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Niu's safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

programme.title: Ghost Sniper / 幽靈狙擊手
programme.desc: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

programme.title: Ghost Story / 聊齋新傳之畫皮人
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Sheng fortuitously rescues the fox demon Xiang Er and brings her home. Unaware of her identity, he falls in love with her, hoping for her to become his concubine. However, Xiang Er is manipulated by the old demoness to do evil and harm people. Will their paranormal love triumph over darkness, allowing them to live happily ever after?

programme.title: Crocodile Island / 鱷夢島
programme.desc: A reality adventure show takes place on Crocodile Island, where participants from diverse backgrounds compete for a priceless golden egg. They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

programme.title: Fighting Darksider / 屠魔戰神
programme.desc: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhang's son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the sword's power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

programme.title: Gold Medal Protection / 金牌保鑣
programme.desc: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Ning's sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Ning's sister?

programme.title: Laoshan Taoist / 嶗山道士
programme.desc: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the master's teachings of "Think No Evil". As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

programme.title: Brother Wolf / 臥狼行動
programme.desc: Recruited from prison for an undercover mission, convict Da Fei returns to the criminal underworld to investigate his former sworn brother, who stole a cartel drug shipment. However, when ruthless mercenaries kidnap his mother, Da Fei joins forces with border police in a desperate battle for justice and redemption.

programme.title: Detective Dee: The Sky Red-eye / 狄仁傑之恢詭赤目
programme.desc: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wu's birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

programme.title: Master So Dragon Subduing Palms 2 / 降龍神掌蘇乞兒2
programme.desc: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

programme.title: Infernal Storm / 無間風暴
programme.desc: Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shan's identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jin's conspiracy.

programme.title: The Tai Chi Master / 張三豐
programme.desc: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

programme.title: Eye for an Eye / 目中無人
programme.desc: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

programme.title: Headless General / 竊天書之無頭將軍
programme.desc: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

programme.desc: Recruited from prison for an undercover mission, convict Da Fei returns to the criminal underworld to investigate his former sworn brother, who stole a cartel drug shipment. However, when ruthless mercenaries kidnap his mother, Da Fei joins forces with border police in a desperate battle for justice and redemption.

programme.title: Detective Dee: The Sky Red-eye / 狄仁傑之恢詭赤目
programme.desc: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wu's birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

programme.title: Master So Dragon Subduing Palms 2 / 降龍神掌蘇乞兒2
programme.desc: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

programme.title: Infernal Storm / 無間風暴
programme.desc: Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shan's identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jin's conspiracy.

programme.title: The Tai Chi Master / 張三豐
programme.desc: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

programme.title: Eye for an Eye / 目中無人
programme.desc: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

programme.title: Headless General / 竊天書之無頭將軍
programme.desc: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

programme.title: Ultra Protection / 非常保鏢
programme.desc: Tong Song is a genius but unfortunately lost his limbs in a car accident. He sets up a security services company with a computer expert and a skilful fighter, and their first job is to protect a dog. The job seems quite simple, but it turns out to be a perilous task as they unravel a conspiracy behind the mission.

programme.title: The Mystical Treasure / 白門五甲
programme.desc: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

programme.title: Crazy Beggar SuQiEr / 瘋魔神捻蘇乞兒
programme.desc: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opium's harm on people.

programme.title: My Kungfu Girlfriend / 我的野蠻女掌門
programme.desc: Yu Sheng Nan rushes to get married to fulfil her dying father's wish and forces Niu, a man she just knew, to sign a bogus marriage agreement. As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Niu's safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: Robot Apocalypse
programme.desc: When expert hacker Tara tries to stop a powerful and sentient A.I. from taking over the world's military, the A.I. marks her as a terrorist who must be exterminated…

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Agent of Death
programme.desc: After undergoing a secret government experiment, CIA operative Tara gains the ability to shapeshift into anyone through DNA transformation, making her the ultimate infiltrator. When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

programme.title: A Sealed Book
programme.desc: When the world is plunged into eternal darkness, adventurer Xiao Wu sets out to find a sealed ancient book that controls the universe. programme.title: The Revenge

programme.title: Malee
programme.desc: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancer's headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estate's dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler / 玉女嬉春
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Merry Wife / 娃娃夫人
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island / 蘭嶼之歌
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him…

programme.title: Double Bliss / 雙喜臨門
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong’s songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple / 佛都有火
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost / 鬼屋麗人
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes / 女兒國
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix / 鳳還巢
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders / 大殺四方
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space / 姦人鬼
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman / 魔劍俠情
programme.desc: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him to battle the deadly Money Clan, a rising threat determined to dominate the martial world.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow / 女秀才
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General’s daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan / 鐵扇公主
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan’s fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Scandal / 醜聞
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Euromaxx - EP 477

The show aims to inspire viewers with the techniques and tips needed to master everyday cooking.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen’s India - EP 8

Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger is a 3D animated musical series designed by the BarryTiger brand for children aged 1-8. The show features a wide range of themes, diverse scenes, and captivating content. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a true audiovisual feast for children.

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. programme.title: Ebb and Flo
