programme.desc: When the townsfolk decorate the Harmony Harbor holiday tree but lose the treetop star, TZG secretly search for it in the yard of a notoriously scary house. / When it transpires the house is not-so-scary after all and belongs to shy inventor Dr. Greenlittle, TZG secretly leads her to the big Harmony Harbor sing-along so that she doesn't have to spend the holiday alone.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Big Sleep-Walk / Of Course You Can - EP 18
programme.desc: When Ian starts to sleepwalk around Harmony Harbor, TZG secretly guides him back to his own bed where he can continue sleeping safely. / When Felicia wants to run an obstacle course for the first time but is afraid she’ll embarrass herself, TZG secretly boosts her confidence by helping with practice.

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Teacher of the Year - EP 57
programme.desc: Mrs. Hogenmuller is being evaluated for a “Teacher of the Year” award, and Olivia is determined to make sure everything goes smoothly. But despite her best efforts, chaos ensues. Luckily, she has a plan to show Mrs. H. that she doesn’t need an award to be teacher of the year in the eyes of her students!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Little Big House - EP 58
programme.desc: When Dad’s elaborate scale house model is destroyed, Olivia takes it upon herself to build another one before Dad returns home with his important client. What’s more, her version will be better, redder, and bigger – so big that she and Ian have to build it in the backyard!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Olivia Talks Turkey - EP 59
programme.desc: Inspired by Mrs. Hogenmuller, Olivia takes up a new hobby – turkey calling! She turns out to be a natural, and before long, she’s attracted a turkey. But when the turkey takes a real liking to her and refuses to leave her side, Olivia has to find a way to make it leave her alone!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Takes a Hike - EP 60
programme.desc: Dad accompanies Olivia and Francine as they set out to earn a Pioneer Scouts merit badge by planting a flag atop Maywood Hill. Along the way, the trio faces one obstacle after another – including a skunk! But thanks to Olivia’s preparedness, they overcome each hurdle and make it to the top!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Invasion Of The Bog Monsters / Now You See Me, Now You Don't - EP 41
programme.desc: Invasion of the Bog Monsters ‐ Casper has built a special whistle to attract bats, but when he tries to test the whistle, Bog Monsters from all over the Forbidden Forest are attracted to Scare School by its sound. When Professor Burns accidentally swallows the whistle after having confiscated it from Casper, The Bog Monsters start invading the school and create a huge mess by turning everyone they touch into bog‐monsters too. Even Mantha is turned into a Bog Monster! Casper, with Ra’s help, must

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Love Potion / Stage Fright - EP 42
programme.desc: Love Potion ‐ The little monsters are in ‘POTION CLASS’, concocting new and untried potions with professor Burns. Casper accidently tries to brighten things up and ends up with a bright pink potion that put the fear into Prof Burns. Oh NO! Casper’s made LOVE POTION, A dreaded, lovely, sweet thing that has no place in Scare School. Casper’s told to get rid of it, and throws it away in the Forbidden Forest. But three little dragons drink the potion and turn into pink kissing machines, turning anyo

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Missing Marcus / The Baby-Glitter’s Club - EP 19
programme.desc: When Marcus leaves for sleep-away camp, Phoebe discovers that being a “family fairy” means helping everyone in your assigned family, not just the children. / When Tracy hires Cassie to babysit Nicholas, and Eden asks Athena and Phoebe to lend a helping hand, Cassie and the Dews must find a way to get Nicholas to bed without his missing and beloved penguin stuffy.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Hammy in the House / To Go Lunch - EP 20
programme.desc: When Eden finds an "injured" Hammy out of his cage and helps him recuperate in her own home, she finds it harder and harder to get her "new guest" to return to his own home. / When Marcus forgets his lunch at home, Phoebe and the Dews must find a way to deliver him his lunch during his class's field trip to the park, but when they lose his lunch they must work to create a new and nutritious alternative.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Stuff / Campout - EP 19
programme.desc: When Kelp and Scallop discover Mr. Pearly has a cave full of stuff they help him to realize it could help a lot of other sea creatures. / When the group goes camping, Kelp helps Ollie learn that even though it didn’t go exactly as planned, they can still have loads of fun.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Family Trip / Great Great Grandicorn - EP 20
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop help Dad discover the true meaning of family trips. / When the Great Great Grandicorn comes to visit, the kids learn that making mistakes is part of learning.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Crash Course - EP 11
programme.desc: Burple and Winger each injure a wing while they're with Dak, and only teamwork can get them home. At the roost, Cutter gets stuck in a puddle of goo.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Furious Fun - EP 12
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders have a "Dragon Day" to show their skills to a young fan, but Aggro skips it to hang out with her new fun -- but reckless -- friends.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - The Fairy Festival! - EP 37
programme.desc: Kitty Fairy's garden is transformed into a fairy-riffic fairground for The Fairy Festival! At the festival, Gabby and Pandy meet an excitable little fairy named Luli-loo who joins them as they explore the festival. Luli-loo may not be the best at all the fair games, but she's never afraid to give it a go and learn from her mistakes!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Fairy Tales - EP 38
programme.desc: The Gabby Cats put their own spin on the classic fairytales "Rapunzel," "The Princess and the Pea," and "Little Red Riding Hood." For the Cat of the Day Segment, CatRat sings a song!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - CupKate - EP 12
programme.desc: It’s Kate’s birthday and everyone in the habitat has something amazing planned- but Melman’s worried that his homemade/hoof-made gift won’t measure up. While on a no-holds barred quest to get Kate her favorite cupcakes, Melman learns the gift doesn’t matter, as long as it comes from the heart.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Pest Side Story - EP 13
programme.desc: Gloria becomes determined to earn her Queen of Kindness Kidizen badge and welcomes some free-spirited rats who need a place to stay into the habitat. Despite her discomfort, Gloria encourages the rats to make themselves at home. When the rats play with her special baby tusk at the bottom of her tank, she finally snaps and sends the rats home. It isn't until the gang winds up at the rats' nest and Gloria almost takes a slice of the rats special cheese that she learns it's okay to say no.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Win a Day with Nitro Ned / Lil' Chickies - EP 39
programme.desc: Archibald wins a contest and gets the opportunity to spend an entire day with his hero: NITRO NED! But when it turns out Ned is in dire need of a day off, Archibald helps to find him a replacement. / After a lotion related mishap, Archibald accidentally turns himself and his family into younger versions of themselves.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Something Old, Something New / The Ghoster - EP 40
programme.desc: Archibald stumbles into playing the part of a wedding planner as he attempts to help a frazzled groom pull off the perfect day. / Archibald unknowingly buys a haunted toaster and summons a ghost by mistake.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Moosebumps!: Chapter Two - EP 11
programme.desc: After Bullwinkle drinks a monster serum, he can’t control when he turns into a big hairy monster, so he and Rocky go on the run from angry mobs and internet celebrities

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Moosebumps!: Chapter Three - EP 12
programme.desc: Bullwinkle and Rocky fly to a mysterious monster-inhabited island to meet the missing mad scientist that created the serum that turned Bullwinkle into a monster, only to learn of the biggest, meanest monster on the island, Humongalon

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - My Fair Foosa - EP 11
programme.desc: To bring peace to his kingdom, King Julien “civilizes” a Foosa.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Diapers Are The New Black - EP 12
programme.desc: King Julien discovers diapers and brings style to his lemur subjects, igniting a fashion war.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Sitting On Babies / Best Frenemies - EP 12
programme.desc: Things go very wrong when Tip and Oh watch the Gorg babies at a cheese-themed playland/Captain Smek pretends to be Oh's friend just to ruin his day.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Beast - EP 18
programme.desc: Po and team play a game of Pok-ta-pok against a family of armadillos for the opportunity to talk one on one with Zuma, the leader. programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - An Uphill Battle - EP 19
programme.desc: The Dragon Knights make a deal for the Storm Wheel but first must obtain the other Storm Wheel from a mysterious mad scientist. Though Mastodon continues to warn the team about the dangers in using the Tianshang Weapons, they use them in a fight against Klaus and Veruca. The clash of the weapons wakes a dormant volcano!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Mad Scientist - EP 20
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blade's brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Game Of Crows - EP 35
programme.desc: The Croods and Bettermans take in Malachi, Gran's longtime enemy, until his broken wing heals. Eep is unsure whether or not Malachi can be trusted.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Pie Hard - EP 36

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Snack of Dawn - EP 37
programme.desc: Dawn is bummed when an injury prevents her from joining the Croods and Bettermans to a trip to Fizzy Falls, but when Thunk recruits her on his quest for an ancient stash of legendary snacks, Dawn can't resist joining the treasure hunt.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Incineration Day - EP 39
programme.desc: The Spy Racers learn from Ms. Nowhere about Incineration Day, an agency “holiday” where spy tech is destroyed in a fun, safe, stress-relieving explosion. But when a mysterious figure steals the warehouse full of to be destroyed spy tech, the team heads to Europe to embark on their most dangerous mission yet.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Snowed In - EP 40
programme.desc: The team uncovers the person behind the Incineration Day theft: General Dudley! While tracking him down, they’re led into an ambush in the Swiss Alps. Is the general just a pawn in a larger plan?

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Rafaela’s Raf-venge - EP 41
programme.desc: The team realizes that they’re being led on a wild goose chase and that the person behind it all must be the one and only Rafaela! She’s broken out of prison and is now causing havoc in Berlin using the dangerous stolen spy tech – which makes her more formidable that ever before.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Something Rotten On Beserker Island - EP 55

Together, they launch a final mission to settle old scores and clear Boss Baby’s name.

programme.desc: Maya works hard to repay her father's debts through her family's shrimp-farming business. Trouble arises when her father tells her that many of the shrimp in the ponds have died. Bagas arrives at his father's request to meet Maya, who insists that he help her settle the debt quickly so she will not have to marry the man who lent her father money.

programme.title: TAJWID CINTA - EP151
programme.desc: Dafri plans to return to Indonesia to meet Alina and get engaged, but his plans are disrupted when Syifa's wedding falls apart after her fiancé, Ilham, disappears. Dafri is eventually arranged to marry Syifa, whom he has only just met, because his father owes Syifa's parents a debt of gratitude. Their arranged marriage leads to a series of conflicts.

programme.title: Singkat Padat Langsung Akad
programme.desc: Sadam (Ridho Ilahi), a police officer who often conducts raids, catches Melly (Larasati Nugroho), his first love from the past, during one of them. Melly is surprised that Sadam still recognizes her, then becomes happy to have him back in her life.

programme.title: SUCI DALAM CINTA - EP54
programme.desc: Almira works hard to repay her father's debts and support her mother and younger sister. Only God knows whether fate will bring her happiness or tears.

programme.title: LE GOÛT DES RENCONTRES NORMANDES(普)
programme.desc: 每周播出四大主題的高品質節目：美食烹飪、居家生活、旅遊經歷和時尚品味。帶領觀眾近距離感受獨特的法式生活藝術和法語國家風情，是台灣唯一以「法式品味」為主題的頻道，原汁原味的法語節目配上全繁體中文字幕，使不懂法語的觀眾也能輕鬆體會法式生活的浪漫。推薦節目有《法式時尚》、《露天廚房》、《擁抱綠色環保》、《熱愛探索的 BÉGIN》

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Sorotan Dunia Sepekan

programme.title: Bincang Spesial

Melalui percakapan yang tajam, program ini berupaya membongkar sisi lain narasumber, termasuk tantangan dan prinsip hidup mereka. Dengan penyampaian intim dan personal, Bincang Spesial bertujuan memberikan wawasan eksklusif, menginspirasi, dan mendorong pemahaman tentang kepemimpinan serta kontribusi dalam masyarakat. programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 3
programme.desc: Police officer Chow Sing Sing is assigned to work undercover investigating the murder of millionaire Million Wong, to whom Chow has an uncanny resemblance, by posing as an amnesiac Wong.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic girl travels to Hong Kong in search of certain love but instead meets a kind-hearted professional fighter for whom she begins to fall instead.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later passes and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a Chinese illegal immigrant, Cheung Kwan-chow, and his journey in New York.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs 2
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Lily Ho portrays the feared swordswoman Silver Fox, who witnessed her father senselessly wounded and her mother raped. 18 years later it's payback time.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs to teach her martial arts skills.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and taking revenge.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang is a young girl not afraid to fight back against hooligans. Unfortunately, she mistakes the handsome Ma Ta-hai, for one such hoodlum. The two are immediately attracted but refuse to admit their true feelings.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Another film inspired by the Chinese classic tale Journey to the West. This memorable version presents a unique interpretation with humour, action, and fantasy galore.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: In Pale Passion, Chin Ping-hsings only directed film, the gorgeous Chiang Li-ping plays a scorned wife Ah Hsia in an unsettling tale about cheating, adultery and blatant abuse, which develops into a deadly love triangle.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master named 'Shadow Whip', he is suspected and hunted.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is one of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When he starts to question the morality of his missions, he becomes a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Li Ching, a 17-year-old girl who marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when Li decides to go to the same school with her husband but attempting to hide their relationship.

programme.title: The Web Of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called 'Five Poison Web', spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li stars in the story of two students looking to persuade their parents to bless their marriage. The lovebirds hatch what they think is a foolproof plan: they play dead!

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: War of The Arrows
programme.desc: Two brothers, Nam Yi and Ja In flee when their village and family are attacked by the Manchu army of the Qing Dynasty. 13 years later, Nam Yi grows up to become a great archer. Meanwhile, Ja In will be married off to the son of the Kim Mu Seon family, the family that takes care of them. However, a massacre occurs and Ja-in is kidnapped.

programme.title: A Melody To Remember
programme.desc: During the Korean War, Second Lieutenant Sang-Yeol encounters a group of orphans while leading his platoon. Empathizing with their pain, he makes a choir with the children to protect them.

programme.title: Cadaver
programme.desc: Strange things start happening after a group of med students dissect a cadaver.

programme.title: Rolling
programme.desc: Juri with depression is stuck at home during COVID. As her mother went visit Juri's grandmother, Juri has to run their Kimbap restaurant until her mother returns.

programme.title: The Ultimate Duo
programme.desc: A trouble making veteran detective and a rich rookie detective who go on a work trip to Seoul to re-investigate a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Following
programme.desc: A mystery thriller about a real estate agent who secretly enters clients' homes and becomes obsessed with a deceptive social media influencer. The film explores themes of obsession, identity and the dark side of social media.

programme.title: The Roundup: Punishment
programme.desc: Detective Ma Seok-do joins the Cyber Investigation Team to nab Baek Chang-ki, a former mercenary and the head of an online gambling organization.

programme.title: My Lovely Angel
programme.desc: A man bears the responsibility to take care of a deaf-blind girl unexpectedly, which turns out to be life-changing to both of them.

programme.title: Salmokji: Whispering Water
programme.desc: An incident that unfolds when a filming team goes to a reservoir to update the road view where an unidentified figure was filmed and encounters something in the dark, deep water.

programme.title: Song Fillers

programme.desc: The O'Connells must combat their deadliest enemy yet: a resurrected Emperor and his legion of 10,000 warriors, woken from a 2,000 year-old curse and hungry for brutal world domination.

programme.title: Last Night In Soho
programme.desc: Aspiring fashion designer Eloise is mysteriously able to return to 1960s London, where she encounters dazzling wannabe singer Sandie. But the glamour is not as it seems, and the dreams of the past crack and splinter into something darker.

programme.desc: When Hiccup and Toothless discover an ice cave that is home to hundreds of new wild dragons and the mysterious Dragon Rider, the two friends find themselves at the center of a battle to protect the peace.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World (Studio Universal)
programme.desc: When Hiccup discovers Toothless isn't the only Night Fury, he must seek the Hidden World, a secret Dragon Utopia before a hired tyrant named Grimmel finds it first.

programme.title: Central Intelligence (Studio Universal)
programme.desc: After he reconnects with an awkward pal from high school through Facebook, a mild-mannered accountant is lured into the world of international espionage.

programme.title: Warcraft (Studio Universal)
programme.desc: As an Orc horde invades the planet Azeroth using a magic portal, a few human heroes and dissenting Orcs must attempt to stop the true evil behind this war.

programme.title: How To Train Your Dragon 2
programme.desc: When Hiccup and Toothless discover an ice cave that is home to hundreds of new wild dragons and the mysterious Dragon Rider, the two friends find themselves at the center of a battle to protect the peace.

programme.title: How To Train...: Hidden World
programme.desc: When Hiccup discovers Toothless isn't the only Night Fury, he must seek the Hidden World, a secret Dragon Utopia before a hired tyrant named Grimmel finds it first.

programme.title: Central Intelligence
programme.desc: After he reconnects with an awkward pal from high school through Facebook, a mild-mannered accountant is lured into the world of international espionage.

programme.title: The Land Before Time
programme.desc: An orphaned brontosaurus teams up with other young dinosaurs in order to reunite with their families in a valley.

programme.title: The Mummy (1999)
programme.desc: In ancient Egypt, a forbidden love sparks a deadly betrayal that seals a priest in a cursed tomb. Decades later in 1926, explorers uncover the site and accidentally revive him, forcing them to fight an ancient evil rising again in the desert.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: SHUKE AND BEITA
programme.desc: Two mice, Shuke and Beta, become partners and embark on amazing adventures. They help other animals with their helicopter and tank, gaining love and friendship along the way.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION TELLS THE ADVENTURES OF FIVE SPECIAL TEENS—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, AND IRSHAD—WHICH ARE FOUND AND CARED FOR BY FATHIR. THESE FIVE CHILDREN HAVE UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT SUPERPOWERS. THEY USE THESE POWERS TO SOLVE VARIOUS CASES AND PROBLEMS THAT OCCUR AROUND THEM. IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

programme.title: CHICK N CHIK
programme.desc: WO CHICKENS, ONE FARM, LOTS OF MAYHEM! FOLLOW THE FUNNY ADVENTURES OF CHICK AND CHIK, WHO ALWAYS HAVE SECRET PLANS WHEN THE HUMANS ARE AWAY. BUT THEIR PLANS ARE OFTEN THWARTED BY SQUEAK, THE MEDDLE-SPOILED MOUSE!

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY STARTED A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH'S DREAM STORE, THE EXCITEMENT OF BEING NEIGHBORS WITH CEU KOKOM, TO PAK SOMAT'S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI FOR THE SAKE OF HIS FAMILY. A WARM STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND A MORAL MESSAGE SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 27 HORIZON SEASON 2
programme.desc: LIKO, ROY, AND DOT JOIN NARANJA ACADEMY FOR TERA TRAINING, WHERE THEY MUST FACE VARIOUS GYM LEADERS. DURING THEIR JOURNEY, THEY MEET OLD FRIENDS, MAKE NEW RIVALS, AND FACE THE THREAT OF A GROUP OF EXPLORERS WHO ARE AFTER THE SECRETS OF TERAPAGOS. AS THEY HON THEIR TERASTALS, THEY MUST ALSO FACE THE CHALLENGES OF THE TOURNAMENT AND SUDDEN ATTACKS FROM THE ENEMY.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: MINIBODS
programme.desc: WELCOME TO THE WORLD OF MINIBODS! Join the miniature versions of the iconic Oddbods characters as they embark on exciting and hilarious adventures. Through play and laughter, these friends learn to work together and solve problems in fun and entertaining ways.

programme.title: BABY ZU
programme.desc: Watch the excitement of Momo, Cici, Blu, and the gang. Accompanying your growth and development, Indonesia's golden generation for the world!

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: THE FIXIES
programme.desc: THE FIXIES is a Russian animated series that follows the adventures of the Fixies, tiny creatures who live inside electronic devices. They secretly repair everyday technological problems while teaching viewers about science and technology in a fun and engaging way. The series is designed to help children learn about electronic devices and the importance of properly maintaining them.

programme.title: The Comment

programme.title: Special Report

programme.title: iNews Sport Pagi
programme.desc: The morning sports news program broadcast by iNews TV presents the latest information about the world of sports from within Indonesia and abroad.

programme.title: Lintas iNews Siang

programme.title: THE MAKING OF K-POP
programme.desc:
How Did Kpop Captivate the World?Long before BTS and BLACKPINK became household names, pioneering artists and producers were breaking boundaries and shaping a new sound. Their passion and creativity laid the foundation for the Kpop we know and love today. The Making of Kpop takes us back to the pioneers and the music that started it all — tracing how Kpop emerged, evolved, and grew into a global cultural phenomenon. Behind the dazzling performances and infectious music we love, what stories remain untold? Join us on a journey back to Kpop's roots and discover the story behind the music that captivated the world.
The Making of Kpop. Where the story begins. * YouTube: Sat 9:00 PM (KST)* TV Premiere: Fri 9:00 AM (KST)

Tune into "Within the Frame."

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE C
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: SHOW K-POP [R]
programme.desc:
Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE C
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE B
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: COUNTRYSIDE ESCAPE
programme.desc:
A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea.
More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection.
Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers.
Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:

With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE B
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: SMARTBIZ ACCEL 2(10분)
programme.desc:
Along with the strengthened manufacturing capabilities of various countries all around the world, "Smart Factory" has garnered a lot of attention in the global market. And the government has unveiled and promoted a roadmap "Manufacturing Innovation 3.0," as part of an effort to enhance the competitiveness of the domestic manufacturing sector. Moreover, a domestic major company Samsung Electronics has provided a smart factory solution in order to boost mutual growth with small and medium-sized businesses. SmartBiz Accelerators introduces a variety of domestic small and medium-sized companies that have achieved continuous growth based on the smart factory project provided by Samsung Electronics as well as gives information on the technological competitiveness and the outlook for the companies in the global market.

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE B
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE B
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: SHOW K-POP [R]
programme.desc:
Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias.
FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: COUNTRYSIDE ESCAPE
programme.desc:
A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea.
More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection.
Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers.
Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: WITH SCIENCE, WE LIVE
programme.desc: Humanity has learned from the past, transcended the present, and dreamed of the future."With Science, We Live"explores the frontiers of science alongside some of the world’s leading thinkers, offering insights into what lies ahead and uncovering new possibilities.In an era of rapid change, where are we headed?As we navigate between the vast universe and the smallness of human existence, we reconsider the direction we must take.Now, in this very moment, we imagine the future shaped by our choices—and move forward toward it.

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE B
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: SMARTBIZ ACCEL 2(10분)
programme.desc:
Along with the strengthened manufacturing capabilities of various countries all around the world, "Smart Factory" has garnered a lot of attention in the global market. And the government has unveiled and promoted a roadmap "Manufacturing Innovation 3.0," as part of an effort to enhance the competitiveness of the domestic manufacturing sector. Moreover, a domestic major company Samsung Electronics has provided a smart factory solution in order to boost mutual growth with small and medium-sized businesses. SmartBiz Accelerators introduces a variety of domestic small and medium-sized companies that have achieved continuous growth based on the smart factory project provided by Samsung Electronics as well as gives information on the technological competitiveness and the outlook for the companies in the global market.
#SmartBizAccelerators #ArirangTV #smartfactory #smartfactoryproject #competitiveness_of_manufacturing #strengthening_competitiveness_of_SMEs #expanding_into_overseas_markets #growth_into_globalbusiness

programme.desc: Arirang Special features a variety of unique and special programs produced by Arirang TV. These exciting programs will open your eyes to a new part of the world.

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE B
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

Along with the strengthened manufacturing capabilities of various countries all around the world, "Smart Factory" has garnered a lot of attention in the global market. programme.desc: Arirang Special features a variety of unique and special programs produced by Arirang TV. These exciting programs will open your eyes to a new part of the world.

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE B
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:

The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->
